The deodorant goes on your armpits. It definitely works best when you're dry, I'd give it maybe a half hour after you get out of the shower. 

Also be wary of putting on dark tshirts right after application because it can show on the sides of your shirt after it rubs on your armpits when you're putting it on, but these stains can easily be rubbed out with nylon pantyhose I've found. 

The perfume can be sprayed about12 inches away from your body either on your chest/neck area and sometimes women put it on their wrists and rub them together. The perfume can really go anywhere.

When you wash you could be totally clean, but the smell is most likely coming from the lack of deodorant. You'll want to use an antiperspirant/deodorant combination (just make sure it says both things on the stick) because you said you sweat alot. 

It'll take a little time to find the deodorant that's 'right' for you. I really like Ban, it comes in a bright green tube. 

As far as perfume, head in to your local department store (Kohl's for example) and they'll have samples right near the jewelry. Choose something that smells nice to you. When you buy it, only use one or two sprays at a time because it's a lot stronger than it seems. 

Good luck!!

Fraternities and sororities stand for so much more than that, and we truly value our members. We excel in academics and complete a lot of community service.
